Alex W: Quick sync — planning a 45m mini-workshop with CloudPartnerX next Tue to walk through a reference-arch + Terraform starter kit. Want to align on agenda and owners. Who can run the hands-on demo?
Maria G: I can co-host the workshop. Suggested agenda: 1) ref-arch overview (10m) 2) Terraform quickstart (20m) 3) deploy checklist & QA (10m) 4) Q&A (5m). Does that work? :+1:
Priya S: That sounds good. Do we have a diagram and a simple module we can point them to? Also: who will publish the marketplace template after?
Cheng L: Need to confirm compliance notes for the private deployment path (VPC/KMS). Partner will ask. Can we add a one-slide item on data-flow & key handling?
Alex W: Yep — adding a 5m slide for data-flow & KMS. Ref-arch diagram is in the partner-refkits repo. Terraform starter is a single module under: repos/partner-refkits/cloudpartnerx/terraform/simple-deploy. Planning to demo the minimal path: infra + model pull + runtime config.
Alex W: Terraform snippet we'll demo: 
```hcl
module "cloudpartnerx_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits//cloudpartnerx/terraform/simple-deploy"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  enable_kms = true
}
```
Priya S: Nice — I'll take the tutorial doc and step-by-step commands. I'll add a short troubleshooting section (common port / firewall errors).
Maria G: Can we allocate a demo env under the partner sandbox org? I can ask infra to spin up a temp project with creds limited to 24h. @alex W do you want me to open the infra request?
Alex W: yes please @Maria G — request a 24h sandbox project and add Cheng + Priya as viewers. Tag it "cp-x-miniworkshop-YYYYMMDD".
Cheng L: I'll own the QA smoke tests and run through the deploy matrix (hosted, dedicated, private). Will add a checklist in the repo: tests/smoke/README.md.
enablement-bot: Created meeting at 2025-02-18 16:00 UTC. Invite link: <https://calendar.example.com/event?e=cp-x-miniworkshop>. Checklist template: <https://git.internal/redwood/partner-refkits/enablement-checklist>.
Priya S: I'll draft the step-by-step and push a PR to repos/partner-refkits/cloudpartnerx/docs/quickstart.md by EOD tomorrow.
Alex W: Great — volunteers: Maria (infra+cohost), Priya (docs + tutorial), Cheng (QA). I'll own slides + live demo. We should rehearse 24h before. Thanks all :rocket:
Maria G: +1. Rehearsal slot suggestion: Mon 10:00 UTC?
Cheng L: Works for me.
Priya S: Works. I'll add rehearsal to the calendar.
Alex W: Perfect — I'll update the repo with links and a short runbook. Posting follow-ups here once PRs are live. :thumbsup:
